name: Patchwork Owl
blurb: A round, softly stuffed owl in patchwork cotton, with big appliqué eyes.
description: The owls are what Sewing Mums is best known for. Each one is a round, softly stuffed body with a contrasting patchwork belly panel, fabric appliqué eyes sewn on by hand, and two stubby feet at the bottom so it sits up on a shelf or a bed.

No two come out the same. The prints depend on what is in the basket that week, so the owl you receive will be its own combination of fabrics and eye colours. They are made in more than one size, from small ones that fit in two hands up to floor cushions. Tell us roughly what you are after and we will send photographs of the ones that are finished.
details: Cotton print patchwork, softly stuffed
Fabric appliqué eyes, sewn rather than glued on
Made in several sizes — ask what is ready
Every owl is a different combination of prints
Measurements and washing instructions on request

name: Sun and Moon Cushion
blurb: A softly stuffed cushion in a cloud or star shape, with sleeping eyes stitched on.
description: Small cushions cut in cloud and star shapes from spotted cotton, softly stuffed, with a pair of closed, sleeping eyes embroidered on the front. They are made for a child's bed or a nursery shelf.

A run of colours is made up at a time — mint, pink, red, charcoal, powder blue and lime among them. Only the one photograph exists so far, so ask which shapes and colours are ready and we will send pictures of those.
details: Spotted cotton, softly stuffed
Made in cloud and star shapes
Sleeping eyes embroidered on the front
A run of colours made up at a time
Sizes and washing instructions on request

name: Trio Bundle
blurb: Three matching pieces — wallet, pouch and cup carrier — cut from one print.
description: A set of three, every piece cut from the same cotton: a wallet that closes on a snap, a flap pouch, and a cup carrier on a webbing strap that takes a takeaway cup or a tumbler.

It is made up in a few prints at a time — the four shown here are a blue and turquoise mandala, bright rainbow circles, a red and ochre retro floral, and an autumn toadstool. Ask which prints are currently made up and we will send pictures of what is ready.

name: Tissue Pouch
blurb: A small cotton sleeve that holds a pocket pack of tissues.
description: A little cotton sleeve sized around a pocket pack of tissues, so the packet stops splitting open at the bottom of a bag.

They are made from whatever cotton is on the table, which is why the photographs show so many at once — florals, batiks and stripes, and novelty prints with dinosaurs, teddy bears and cartoon faces for children. Tell us who it is for and we will pick a few and send pictures.

A run of colours is made up at a time — natural, black, blue, green, orange, pink and brown. Only the one photograph exists so far, so ask what is ready and we will send pictures of those.

name: Placemats
blurb: Cotton placemats, backed and topstitched, in a long run of prints.
description: Plain rectangular placemats, each one cut from a cotton print and backed in a second fabric so they lie flat on the table and can go through the wash. The edge is turned and topstitched.

These are made in a long run of prints — florals, tartans, batiks, plains and novelty cottons — and the stack changes as fabric comes in. Tell us how many you need and roughly the colours of your table, and we will photograph what is made up.
details: Cotton print front, backed in a second fabric
Topstitched edge, machine washable
Florals, tartans, batiks, plains and novelty prints
Any number, from a pair to a full table

name: Coasters
blurb: Padded fabric coasters, some pieced from four prints, some cut from one.
description: Small padded squares to sit under a glass or a mug. Some are pieced as a four-patch, with a different print in each quarter; others are cut from a single cotton and topstitched round the edge.

They are made in sets from offcuts, so a combination is rarely repeated exactly. The bright ones photographed here are in bold graphic prints; there are quieter florals and novelty cottons too. Tell us how many you need and we will photograph what is made up.
details: Padded cotton squares, for a glass or a mug
Either pieced as a four-patch or cut from a single print

Sold in sets; any number on request

name: Heat Pads
blurb: A long cotton pad to warm and rest on a sore shoulder, back or stomach.
description: A slim rectangular pad, filled and sewn shut, made to be warmed and laid across a stiff neck, a sore shoulder or an aching stomach. Each one has a Sewing Mums label stitched onto the front.

They are made in long runs from whatever cotton is on the table, which is why the photographs show so many at once — paisleys, florals, plains, and a set of Christmas cottons with reindeer, wreaths and snowflakes. Ask what is made up and we will send pictures.
details: Cotton, filled and sewn shut, with a Sewing Mums label on the front
Long and slim, to sit across a shoulder or the small of a back
Made in long runs, so the prints change constantly
Christmas prints made up ahead of December
Filling, measurements and heating instructions on request

name: Toddler Patchwork Blanket
blurb: A patchwork cot blanket pieced from cotton prints, backed in a contrasting fabric.
description: Squares and triangle blocks of cotton print, pieced into a blanket sized for a cot, a pram or a toddler's bed, then backed with a single contrasting fabric and bound all the way round the edge.

Because they are pieced from whatever is in the basket, every blanket is a one-off. Some come out bright and busy with children's novelty prints; others are quieter, worked in a limited set of colours. Ask and we will show you what is finished rather than have you choose from a photograph of something already gone.
details: Cotton patchwork top, contrasting cotton backing
Bound edge all the way round
Pieced in squares or triangle blocks depending on the blanket
Every blanket is a one-off
Sizes and washing instructions on request

name: Bookish Bundle
blurb: A themed reading and stationery set, put together as a ready-to-give gift.
description: Each bundle is built around a colour theme and assembled as a complete gift: a notebook, a small drink bottle, a set of gel pens, sticky notes and page flags, keyring charms, stickers, a reading log card, and handmade fabric extras like a scrunchie and a padded pouch in a matching print.

Bundles are put together in small runs and the contents change from one to the next, so the photographs show a few of the combinations that have gone out rather than a fixed list. Tell us who it is for and roughly what they read, and we will suggest one.
details: Notebook, drink bottle, gel pens, sticky notes and page flags
Keyring charms, stickers and a reading log card
Handmade fabric scrunchie and pouch in matching prints

name: Christmas Placemats
blurb: Placemats in Christmas cottons, made for the season and then put away.
description: The same placemats as the everyday ones, cut from Christmas cotton: reindeer and snowflakes, gingerbread men, holly, baubles, wreaths and gold stars, mostly on red, green and cream grounds.
These are made up ahead of December and go back in the drawer afterwards, so the prints change from one year to the next. Tell us how many you need and we will send photographs of what is finished.
